title: Replacing the controller and checking both links
captions: The procedure card lists each step in order.
Isolate, test for zero, replace, close, then restore power.
Then test the local link and the Earth link, each on its own.
Accept only an exact reply. One good link proves only itself.
verify: Decision choice clicks are added after a --dump of the M4-20 panel (Choice_<field>_<id> names).
